SELECT p.portrait_id, p.asset_id, p.name, p.gender, p.scene_tags_json, p.note, CASE WHEN a.status = 'ready' THEN 'ready' WHEN a.status IN ('verifying', 'delete_pending') THEN 'processing' ELSE 'failed' END AS availability_status, a.failure_reason, a.original_name AS original_file_name, a.content_type, a.file_format, a.width, a.height, a.file_size, p.record_revision, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM av_portrait p INNER JOIN av_asset a ON a.asset_id = p.asset_id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND p.del_flag = '0'
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(p.scene_tags_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.gender = #{gender}
AND a.status = 'ready'
AND a.status IN ('verifying', 'delete_pending')
AND a.status IN ('rejected', 'failed', 'delete_failed')
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
